answer: An ocean forecasting market tracking each zephyr could price hollow identities with a fresh hash puzzle. Hash the earning key, epoch, unpredictable public beacon and nonce; admit only a hash below a published target. Validators reject proofs for another key or epoch. Every added alias needs separate nonce searches and electricity, even in a parallel colluding farm. Set expected cost above the capped extra-alias subsidy, accounting for fast hardware. This trusts an unbiased beacon, no cheap hash shortcut and an enforced cap. Newcomers can start at modest hardware difficulty.
